requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model named ClinicalTrialProximityScore with fields distance_miles (float), duration_minutes (float), normalized_score (float), and metadata (object).
The system must constrain normalized_score to a numeric range between 0 and 100 inclusive.
The system must enforce distance_miles to be a non-negative float.
The system must enforce duration_minutes to be a non-negative float.
The system must include metadata fields route_source (string) and timestamp (ISO 8601 string) within the metadata object.
The system must validate that route_source is populated when distance_miles or duration_minutes are provided.
The system must serialize the ClinicalTrialProximityScore model into JSON compatible with existing clinical trial response schemas.
The system must integrate the proximity score schema into existing clinical trial models without breaking backward compatibility of existing fields.
The system must allow the proximity score object to be optional in the clinical trial model.
The system must reject model instantiation when normalized_score is outside the 0-100 range.
The system must reject model instantiation when distance_miles or duration_minutes are negative values.
The system must support null or missing metadata when proximity data is not yet computed.
The system must ensure timestamp is automatically populated if not explicitly provided during model creation.
The system must ensure compatibility with clinical_trials_service inputs and outputs for distance and duration fields.
